markdown:
| Symptom                                  | Cause                                                                                | Remedy                                                                                                                                         |
|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| The stuffing box is leaking excessively. | The packing gland is not adjusted properly.                                          | Tighten the gland nuts.                                                                                                                        |
| The stuffing box is leaking excessively. | The stuffing box is not packed properly.                                             | Check the packing and repack the box.                                                                                                          |
| The stuffing box is leaking excessively. | The mechanical seal parts are worn.                                                  | Replace the worn parts.                                                                                                                        |
| The stuffing box is leaking excessively. | The mechanical seal is overheating.                                                  | Check the lubrication and cooling lines.                                                                                                       |
| The stuffing box is leaking excessively. | The shaft sleeve is scored.                                                          | Machine or replace the shaft sleeve as necessary.                                                                                              |
| The motor requires excessive power.      | The discharge head has dropped below the rated point and is pumping too much liquid. | Install a throttle valve. If this does not help, then trim the impeller diameter. If this does not help, then contact your ITT representative. |
| The motor requires excessive power.      | The liquid is heavier than expected.                                                 | Check the specific gravity and viscosity.                                                                                                      |
| The motor requires excessive power.      | The stuffing-box packing is too tight.                                               | Readjust the packing. If the packing is worn, then replace the packing.                                                                        |
| The motor requires excessive power.      | Rotating parts are rubbing against each other.                                       | Check the parts that are wearing for proper clearances.                                                                                        |
| The motor requires excessive power.      | The impeller clearance is too tight.                                                 | Adjust the impeller clearance.                                                                                                                 |
